<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Incident" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/incident">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Incident" name="Incident handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_IncidentReported" name="Incident reported">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportIncident" name="Report incident">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogReport" name="Log report in tracking system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignTeam" name="Assign appropriate team">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherInformation" name="Gather necessary information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyCause" name="Identify incident cause">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProposeActions" name="Propose corrective actions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ImplementSolution" name="Implement solution (fix, training, or policy change)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FollowUp" name="Follow up to ensure the issue will not recur">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CloseAndNotify" name="Close report and notify stakeholders">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseReport" name="Close incident report">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyStakeholders" name="Notify all stakeholders">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CloseAndNotifyJoin" name="Closure and notification complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_IncidentHandled" name="Incident report closed and stakeholders notified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_IncidentReported" targetRef="Task_ReportIncident"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_ReportIncident" targetRef="Task_LogReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_LogReport" targetRef="Task_AssignTeam"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_AssignTeam" targetRef="Task_GatherInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_GatherInformation" targetRef="Task_IdentifyCause"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyCause" targetRef="Task_ProposeActions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ProposeActions" targetRef="Task_ImplementSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_ImplementSolution" targetRef="Task_FollowUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_FollowUp" targetRef="Gateway_CloseAndNotify"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_CloseAndNotify" targetRef="Task_CloseReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_CloseAndNotify" targetRef="Task_NotifyStakeholders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_CloseReport" targetRef="Gateway_CloseAndNotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_NotifyStakeholders" targetRef="Gateway_CloseAndNotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_CloseAndNotifyJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_IncidentHandled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
